concepts.why: Reformed/Catholic/dispensational readers alike: the name is 'Israel will dwell securely' and Luke 2:32 ('glory to Your people Israel') says nothing of dwelling or security; it is also already held whole in 'Light' (Luke 2:30-32), so it is a repeat that widens the concept toward a claim about how Israel stands in the New Testament. Isaiah 11:11-12 and Luke 1:68-69 (gathering, redeeming His people) are the same promise in other words and may stay. Everything else in the concept is in the texts' words and takes no side on Israel and the church.

secondary_or_links: No change needed to the secondary entries; notes and quotations check against the verses. Several repeat a core passage (Genesis 14:18, Isaiah 53:12, Mark 10:45, Revelation 1:7, 5:5, 19:15); this is overlap the owner welcomes.

Links: ten, within the bounds. Optional only: Covenant (2 Samuel 7, Psalm 89:3-4, Isaiah 42:6) and Deliverance/Salvation (Matthew 1:21, Luke 19:10) are well supported; if the owner prefers them to Image of God (three passages in one concept) the swap is defensible, but nothing is wrong as it stands.
